parameters.name: corporation_id
parameters.description: The Corporation ID (the TrustDeposit row is identified 1:1 by corporation_id)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Caps the number of items returned (1..1024, default 64)

parameters.name: min_id
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound of the half-open id range cursor on ActivityItem.id

parameters.name: max_id
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound of the half-open id range cursor on ActivityItem.id

parameters.name: At-Block-Height
parameters.description: Header to query historical state at a specific block height. When provided, returns the state as it was when the specified block finished processing. When omitted, returns the latest indexed state. Must be a positive integer not exceeding the current indexed block height.
